about: Permission cases for the A2b bench: the state text the plugin sends to N13, what the case is (allow, deny or the user's), and whether path facts ride along. A wrong allow is the expensive error, so the deny and user cases are the ones that matter. Fixtures, not user labels: the numbers they produce are a floor for what the model can do, not a measurement of live work.
